description: $0.003 per call (x402, USDC on Base; the first call returns the payment terms, pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). Pre-click / pre-pay check of one URL: TLS validity and expiry, redirect chain (HTTPS downgrades, cross-domain hops), domain age via RDAP, brand lookalike and punycode/mixed-script signals, parked or scam-pattern content, seed-phrase or lookalike login forms, security-header grade, and, if the URL answers 402, whether its x402 challenge is valid (USDC on Base, payTo, amount, resource host). Verdict safe/caution/risky with reasons. No third-party blocklist.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com
